opening.argument: The strongest evidence is the walkthrough itself: the speaker shows how to create a YouTube channel, find its verification option in YouTube Studio, and open the monetization section. The displayed monetization page sets out AdSense sign-up and review after the watch-hour and subscriber requirements are met. That is an explanation of platform setup and eligibility, not evidence of a completed transaction. The walkthrough also shows India selected in channel settings and demonstrates a fake address, but the available evidence does not show false information being submitted. It likewise does not show viewers being asked to pay, or any completed verification or payment.
